title: decade keeps a model of the agents in each workspace
body:
Agent state lives on `channel::Client` (`status`, `since`) and goes with the connection.

## Proposal

- A new `src/server/agents.rs` holds `Agent`: session, name, version, workspace, pane, state and since, the last 32 state changes, activity, question, model, context, tokens, cost, last seen, and whether it is connected.
- Agents are keyed by session per workspace. A reconnect with the same session re-attaches to its agent and keeps its history.
- A disconnected agent stays, shown as disconnected, until it sends `ended` or 10 minutes pass.
- The router feeds the model. `Client.status` and `since` move into it, along with notifications, the "raised" check and clearing a mark.
- A new MCP tool `agents` lists the agents in the caller's workspace.
- Everything is in memory. Agents do not survive a server restart.
close_reason: Landed in f025309. `src/server/agents.rs` holds the model on `Router`, and the `agents` MCP tool lists it.
